channel.title: The Smithfield Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Smithfield Times (smithfieldtimes.com)

item.title: Rare triple threat: Nor’easter to bring blizzard, flooding and freezing to Smithfield
item.description: Winter Storm Gianna could bring blizzard conditions, moderate tidal flooding, days of subfreezing temps and 6-8 inches of snow to Isle of Wight and Surry counties. Smithfield has seen similar winter nor'easters before, but rarely.

item.title: IW Education Foundation awards over $36K in teacher grants
item.description: The Isle of Wight Education Foundation awarded 37 Isle of Wight teacher grants totaling $36,760 to fund innovative classroom projects across eight schools, funded by its annual gala.

item.title: Preparing for Emergencies: What You Should Do After a Serious Crash
item.description: A serious car crash can change a normal day instantly, leaving drivers and passengers unsure of what to do next.

item.title: Column – Crepe myrtle fever gripped IW, Surry a century ago
item.description: Crepe myrtles grew from Victorian-era favorites to a symbol of Smithfield and Surry and remain central to the region’s gardens and streetscapes.

item.title: IW Animal Control seizes nine dogs left outside during Winter Storm Fern
item.description: Isle of Wight County Animal Control officers seized nine hound dogs from a Carrollton home after finding them without adequate food or shelter during Winter Storm Fern. A custody hearing for the dogs is set for Feb. 5.

item.title: Zoning and Permit Considerations for Shipping Containers
item.description: Shipping containers are attractive for storage and small offices because they are strong, modular, and relatively affordable.

item.title: Expected snowfall for IW, Surry drops a day out from Winter Storm Gianna
item.description: Snow forecasts have been lowered for Isle of Wight and Surry counties as Winter Storm Gianna nears, but warnings remain for snow, high winds, subzero wind chills and moderate tidal flooding.

item.title: VDOT sets timeline for Surry County bridge study
item.description: VDOT has set a timeline to study a James River bridge between Surry County and the Peninsula, with findings and recommendations due to state leaders in early 2027.

item.title: DNA links suspect in 1987 Isle of Wight killings to two more murders
item.description: DNA ties a deceased Virginia fisherman to at least six Hampton Roads killings, including 1980s Colonial Parkway and Isle of Wight murders, the FBI recently announced.

item.title: Letter – Keep momentum going for IWCS
item.description: A Smithfield resident urges Isle of Wight County Schools officials to keep up the push to replace aging facilities and buses and increase teacher salaries.
